title: Dashboards
text: I greatly enjoy building an interactive dashboard to explain complicated concepts or to let others explore data for themselves. To that end, below are a few of my favorites. Some are educational tools I used in teaching, the others are fun apps for exploring data. All run in the browser or on a free host.

title: Zach Schroeder
text:
Email  GitHub  LinkedIn  Scholar  Résumé


How do we use language understand one another?
I’m a behavioral scientist and statistician with seven years of experience researching this question. I’ve built an analytic pipeline that transcribed and analyzed 20 years of video-recorded conversations to examine what the best cues are for understanding what someone is thinking; I examined emotional and semantic drift in ~8 million Tweets discussing ‘cancel culture’ on social media; and I used survey data to understand how students’ feelings of belonging impact how they interpret ambiguous academic feedback
If I’m not wrangling data at my desk, I’m deep in the woods with my dog.
